skill_name: Describe how a telephone works in two paragraphs.
workflow: A telephone is a communication device used to transmit and receive sound, usually in the form of a conversation. It uses a type of electronic circuitry called a circuit-switched network to enable two or more users to communicate with each other over a long distance. A telephone works by converting sound into electrical signals and sending them over a network of copper or fiber-optic cables.
